I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread: "Thanks, Pree. Got the correction: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. Nothing else to do on my side."

Gate 47 is now the site. Dock 23 was wrong, but it's still in the earlier thread, where my reply repeats it. I haven't edited or deleted either post. If you want the earlier one fixed, Pree can edit hers, or I can add a note to that thread pointing to the correction.
